# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Documentation delivery modernization**

## Highlights

Upcoming packages will carry compiler-generated XML documentation alongside the managed assemblies. API documentation now lives with the C# APIs it describes, keeping package reference documentation aligned with the shipped surface.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## API Surface

- **Package XML documentation is aligned with the managed API** — Compiler-generated XML documentation will ship beside the managed assemblies, improving IDE and package-consumer reference information. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080))
